aka.zh: 库特尼天路（萨尔莫至克雷斯顿）

tagline.en: Across the grain of southern British Columbia, close to the US border, over a string of mountain passes from Hope to the Rockies
tagline.zh: 紧贴美国边境、横切不列颠哥伦比亚南部的群山，从霍普翻越一连串山口直抵落基山脉

start.en: Hope, at the head of the Fraser Valley, where it leaves Highway 1
start.zh: 菲沙河谷上端的霍普，在此离开 1 号公路

end.en: Crowsnest Pass on the Alberta boundary, where it continues as Alberta Highway 3
end.zh: 阿尔伯塔边界上的鸦巢山口，续为阿尔伯塔 3 号公路

en: Highway 3 runs east–west across the southern edge of British Columbia, never far from the US border, and crosses the mountain ranges rather than following the valleys between them. From Hope it climbs through Manning Park to Allison Pass, drops to Princeton and the Similkameen, crosses Richter Pass to Osoyoos, and then goes over a succession of passes to Grand Forks, Castlegar, Creston, Cranbrook and Fernie before reaching the Rockies at Crowsnest Pass.

The highest of them is the Kootenay Pass between Salmo and Creston, at 1,769 m, which the province has called the highest elevation of any arterial highway in Canada. Much of the route is two-lane mountain road with steep grades and long climbing lanes.
About four-fifths of it follows the line of the Dewdney Trail, a mule track cut in the 1860s to the gold fields of the southern Interior.
zh: 3 号公路沿不列颠哥伦比亚南缘东西向延伸，始终离美国边境不远，而且横切山脉、而非顺着山间河谷而行。它自霍普穿过曼宁公园爬上艾利森山口，下到普林斯顿与锡米尔卡米恩河谷，翻过里克特山口到奥索尤斯，再越过一连串山口经大福克斯、卡斯尔加、克雷斯顿、克兰布鲁克与弗尼，最后在鸦巢山口抵达落基山脉。
其中最高的是萨尔莫与克雷斯顿之间的库特尼山口，海拔 1,769 米，该省称之为加拿大干线公路的最高点。全线大部分是坡陡、爬坡车道很长的双车道山路。
全线约五分之四沿 19 世纪 60 年代开辟的杜德尼小道而行；这条骡道当年通往南部内陆的金矿区。

en: The number was given in 1941, but the road was a set of pieces. The key one was the Hope–Princeton Highway, opened on 2 November 1949, which cut the drive between the coast and the southern Interior from about 300 km by the old route to about 135 km. It was estimated at $2.75 million in 1945 and reported at $12 million on opening; five workers were killed building it.

The other gaps were closed in the 1960s. The Christina Lake–Castlegar section opened in 1962. The Kootenay Skyway over the pass from Salmo to Creston opened on 15 August 1964, cutting that journey from about 160 km to 80 km. The Richter Pass road and the Kinnaird Bridge at Castlegar opened on 7 July 1965, the first shortening the trip by 32 km.

On 9 January 1965 the Hope Slide buried the highway east of Hope under a mountainside of rock and killed four people; a new alignment across the slide was completed in 1982. In November 2021 floods and washouts closed it east of Hope.
zh: 这一编号于 1941 年确定，但当时这条路只是若干段的拼合。关键一段是 1949 年 11 月 2 日通车的霍普—普林斯顿公路，它把沿海与南部内陆之间的车程从旧路的约 300 公里缩短到约 135 公里。该路 1945 年估价 275 万加元，通车时报道造价 1,200 万加元；修建中有五名工人遇难。
其余缺口在 20 世纪 60 年代补齐。克里斯蒂娜湖至卡斯尔加段于 1962 年通车。翻越萨尔莫至克雷斯顿山口的“库特尼天路”于 1964 年 8 月 15 日通车，使这段行程从约 160 公里缩短到 80 公里。里克特山口公路与卡斯尔加的金纳德大桥于 1965 年 7 月 7 日通车，前者使行程缩短 32 公里。
1965 年 1 月 9 日，“霍普山崩”以整片山体的岩石掩埋了霍普以东的公路，四人遇难；穿越崩塌区的新线形于 1982 年完工。2021 年 11 月，洪水与冲毁使霍普以东路段中断。

value.en: 838.7 km summed from the ministry's 2026 section inventory; English Wikipedia gives 841 km.
value.zh: 据该厅 2026 年分段清单累加为 838.7 公里；英文维基百科作 841 公里。

figures.source: British Columbia Ministry of Transportation and Transit, Landmark Kilometre Inventory, edition 202607 (computed); English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 3

value.en: No route-wide figure. Hope–Princeton Highway $12 million on opening (1949), against a 1945 estimate of $2.75 million.
value.zh: 无全线数字。霍普—普林斯顿公路通车时 1,200 万加元（1949 年），1945 年估价为 275 万加元。

value.en: The province, through the Department of Public Works and later the Department of Highways.
value.zh: 省政府，经由公共工程厅及其后的公路厅。

figures.source: BC Ministry of Transportation, Frontier to Freeway

value.en: 1,769 m on the Salmo–Creston section, 67 km long; described by the ministry as the highest elevation of any arterial highway in Canada.
value.zh: 位于萨尔莫至克雷斯顿段，海拔 1,769 米，该段长 67 公里；该厅称其为加拿大干线公路的最高点。

figures.source: BC Ministry of Transportation, Frontier to Freeway

value.en: Reported as named the Crowsnest Highway in 1977; not checked against a provincial order or gazette.
value.zh: 据报道 1977 年定名为“鸦巢公路”；未经省政府命令或公报核实。

figures.source: Medicine Hat News, as cited in English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 3

timeline.en: The route across southern British Columbia is numbered 3.
timeline.zh: 横越不列颠哥伦比亚南部的路线编为 3 号。

timeline.en: The Hope–Princeton Highway opens on 2 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 2 日，霍普—普林斯顿公路通车。
克里斯蒂娜湖至卡斯尔加段通车。

timeline.en: The Kootenay Skyway from Salmo to Creston opens on 15 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 15 日，萨尔莫至克雷斯顿的“库特尼天路”通车。

timeline.en: The Hope Slide buries the road on 9 January; the Richter Pass road and Kinnaird Bridge open on 7 July.
timeline.zh: 1 月 9 日，“霍普山崩”掩埋公路；7 月 7 日，里克特山口公路与金纳德大桥通车。

timeline.en: Floods in November close the highway east of Hope.
timeline.zh: 11 月，洪水使霍普以东路段中断。
